correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the entire joint-law fiber of three fair pairwise-independent Bernoulli indicators: even/odd parity classes mixed with parameter t=4P(111) in [0,1]. For two strong habitat bonuses a and weak b in (0,a), log-growth E log(sum w_i R_i) is strictly concave on simplex; symmetry yields unique w1=w2=(1-z)/2. Independently differentiated all eight states with SymPy, confirming exactly G_t'(0)=[b(4(a+1)+t a^2)-a(3a+4)]/[4(a+1)(a+2)] and G_t'(1)=[2b-2a-ab]/[4(1+b)]<0. Thus weak habitat enters iff b>a(3a+4)/(4(a+1)+t a^2), equality excludes; endpoints yield b_O and b_E. Exact a=2,b=3/2 witness has transition t=1/3, and optimum interior at odd parity. Strict concavity and all-parameter inequalities prove unrestricted statement; finite checker is corroboration.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge novel exact optimal support-change threshold controlled by a third-order interaction invisible in all first- and second-order moments. Jansen–Yoshimura develop geometric-mean growth in two habitats; Schreiber studies stochastic patch selection under Brownian forcing specified by covariance; foundational Cohen work covers general reproductive optimization but no examined exact parity fiber. A known equal-share growth-rate sensitivity to higher moments does not imply the unique optimizer changes support.
